caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped, cylindrical box with a fitted lid. The box is decorated with a predominantly greenish-blue patterned surface featuring white, cream, and turquoise leafy or floral motifs outlined in red with scattered hints of pink and blue. The lid has a plain blue border that runs around its edge, while the rest of the box—including the body and top—is covered with the same leafy pattern. The box casts a soft shadow to the left and beneath it. The background is plain, light beige, and unembellished. At the lower right corner, there is a handwritten signature that reads "Gilbert Sackermann."
title: Bandbox
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
